resources.string: Long-press your home screen → Widgets → Pinch.

Pinch talks only to Anthropic (api.anthropic.com, platform.claude.com) and the public status page (status.claude.com). No analytics, no ads, no servers of its own.\n\nYour Claude password never touches this app: you type it only on claude.com, in your own browser. The sign-in tokens are encrypted with a key kept in the Android Keystore, never logged, never backed up and never shown. Signing out wipes them from the phone.
